name: Context Trim
description: Replaces the default system prompt with a compact prompt for low-context local or edge models and summarizes project context instead of injecting large workspace files.

enabled.label: Enable Context Trim Mode
enabled.help: When enabled, this plugin can replace the default system prompt with a compact prompt for low-context models.

targets.label: Provider + Model Targets
targets.help: Exact provider/model pairs that should use the compact prompt. The plugin only activates when both provider and model match a configured target.

skills.label: Injected Skills
skills.help: Optional skill names to inject into the compact system prompt. Matching skills are loaded from the workspace or bundled skill sources and rendered into the Skills section.

includeProjectContext.label: Include Project Context Summary
includeProjectContext.help: When enabled, the plugin summarizes selected workspace files into a short Project Context section.

projectFiles.label: Project Files
projectFiles.help: Workspace files to summarize when building compact project context.

perFileCharBudget.label: Per-file Character Budget
perFileCharBudget.help: Maximum characters to keep from each summarized workspace file.

totalProjectCharBudget.label: Total Project Context Budget
totalProjectCharBudget.help: Maximum total characters across all summarized workspace files.

extraInstructions.label: Extra Instructions
extraInstructions.help: Optional extra operator instructions appended to the compact system prompt.

logging.label: Enable Logging
logging.help: Emit info logs when the plugin replaces the default system prompt.
